translationRepairs: 邱瑜子之陶 means Qiu Yu and his son Zhitao.
Biao had studied under Yue Nanxing, a fellow townsman; enemies in the factions resented this and entered his name in the Record of Donglin Comrades.
Biao had studied under Zhao Nanxing, a fellow townsman; enemies in the factions resented this and entered his name in the Record of Donglin Comrades.
越南星 is a misprint for 趙南星, Li Biao's teacher from Gaoyi.
The emperor was furious and was ready to punish Qianyi severely; he also wanted to punish Supervising Secretary Qu Shisun, Censor Fang Kezhuang, and others.
The emperor was furious and was ready to punish Qianyi severely; he also wanted to punish Supervising Secretary Qu Shisi, Censor Fang Kezhuang, and others.
瞿式耜 is read Qu Shisi.
allow Yunru a chance to reform, and impose only light penalties on Shisun and the rest.
allow Yunru a chance to reform, and impose only light penalties on Shisi and the rest.
The National University student Hu Huanyou impeached Guogan and others and stripped them of court dress; Guogan recommended their restoration, and contemporaries praised his magnanimity.
The National University student Hu Huanyou impeached Guogan and others and was stripped of his scholar's status; Guogan recommended his restoration, and contemporaries praised his magnanimity.
褫衣冠 applies to Hu Huanyou, whom Li Guogan had restored.
After his death he was posthumously enfeoffed as Grand Tutor and given the posthumous title Wenmin.
After his death he was posthumously enfeoffed as Grand Guardian and given the posthumous title Wenmin.
Censors Tian Shizhen, Liu Shizhen, Wang Daozhi, Wu Zhiren, and Ren Zanhua, and Supervising Secretary Yan Kedi jointly impeached him; all cases were sent to joint deliberation at court.
Censors Tian Shizhen, Liu Shizhen, Wang Daozhi, Wu Zhiren, and Ren Zanhua, and Supervising Secretary Yan Kebi jointly impeached him; all cases were sent to joint deliberation at court.
閻可陛 is read Yan Kebi.

Minister of Personnel Wang Yongguang and others reported that Daodeng had factionally shielded Grand Secretary Wang Zaijin, the licentiate Zhu Tongshi, and his fellow townsman Chen Yuding in examination appointments—all with verified facts—and he was dismissed and sent home.

Minister of Personnel Wang Yongguang and others reported that Daodeng had factionally shielded Minister of War Wang Zaijin, the licentiate Zhu Tongshi, and his fellow townsman Chen Yuding in examination appointments—all with verified facts—and he was dismissed and sent home.
樞臣 refers to the Minister of War, Wang Zaijin.

When Hongxun arrived he took charge resolutely, denouncing Yang Weiyuan, Li Hengmao, Yang Suoxiu, Tian Jingxin, Sun Zhixi, Ruan Dayue, Xu Shaoji, Zhang Na, Li Fan, Jia Jichun, Huo Weihua, and others—to widespread satisfaction.

When Hongxun arrived he took charge resolutely, denouncing Yang Weiyuan, Li Hengmao, Yang Suoxiu, Tian Jingxin, Sun Zhixi, Ruan Dacheng, Xu Shaoji, Zhang Na, Li Fan, Jia Jichun, Huo Weihua, and others—to widespread satisfaction.
阮大鋮 is read Ruan Dacheng.
Before long Gao Jie memorialized, charging that Hongxun had attacked the traitors Weiyuan, Suoxiu, Jichun, and Dayue while refusing to heed Sun Zhixi's tearful loyal counsel;
Before long Gao Jie memorialized, charging that Hongxun had attacked the traitors Weiyuan, Suoxiu, Jichun, and Dacheng while refusing to heed Sun Zhixi's tearful loyal counsel;
Supervising Secretary Yan Keshou impeached Vice Censor-in-Chief Jia Yuxiang for having been promoted through bribes paid to Hongxun.
Supervising Secretary Yan Kebi impeached Vice Censor-in-Chief Jia Yuxiang for having been promoted through bribes paid to Hongxun.
閻可陛 is read Yan Kebi.
From Hanlin Bachelor he was appointed Compiler and was repeatedly promoted to Junior Mentor.
From Hanlin Bachelor he was appointed Compiler and was repeatedly promoted to Junior Supervisor of the Household of the Heir Apparent.
少詹事 is the junior supervisor of the household administration.

When Emperor Zhuanglie ascended the throne, because Grand Secretaries Huang Liji, Shi Fenglai, Zhang Ruitu, and Li Guo'an had all been men used by Zhongxian and could not be relied on, he ordered court ministers to recommend candidates and ten names were submitted.

When Emperor Zhuanglie ascended the throne, because Grand Secretaries Huang Liji, Shi Fenglai, Zhang Ruitu, and Li Guogan had all been men used by Zhongxian and could not be relied on, he ordered court ministers to recommend candidates and ten names were submitted.
李國𣚴 is read Li Guogan.
Longxi said, "Xiaoliang had a son, Qi Jue—install Qi Jue to recover Wusa; preserving what was endangered and continuing what was broken off is in accord with principle.
Longxi said, "Xiaoliang had a son, An Qijue—install Qijue to recover Wusa; preserving what was endangered and continuing what was broken off is in accord with principle.
其爵 is the son's given name.
The following year, because grain-transport ships had violated prohibitions and passed through customs, the Emperor wished to restore the post of Grand Coordinator of Grain Transport.
The following year, because grain-transport ships had violated prohibitions and passed through customs, the Emperor wished to restore the post of Regional Commander of Grain Transport.
漕運總兵官 is a regional commander.

In the eighth month of the third year, Shi Fu memorialized again: "Longxi backed Chonghuan's killing of the general that brought disaster to the army, promoted peace negotiations with the enemy, and lent credence to the boast that Liaodong would be recovered within five years.

In the eighth month of the third year, Shi Li memorialized again: "Longxi backed Chonghuan's killing of the general that brought disaster to the army, promoted peace negotiations with the enemy, and lent credence to the boast that Liaodong would be recovered within five years.
They then voted for Longxi's execution and, following the precedent of Xia Yan, prepared the West Market at the Eastern Depot for his death.
They then voted for Longxi's execution and, following the precedent of Xia Yan, set up an execution ground at the West Market to await him.
設廠西市 means an execution ground in the West Market.

When Zhao Nanxing of Gaoyi and his townsman Wei Dazhong fell victim to the eunuch faction, and when his Jiangxi classmate Wan Zuan was beaten to death in pursuit of restitution, he threw himself into their defense at the cost of his fortune—and won the Donglin faction's esteem.

When Zhao Nanxing of Gaoyi and his townsman Wei Dazhong fell victim to the eunuch faction, and when his Jiangxi classmate Wan Jing was beaten to death in pursuit of restitution, he threw himself into their defense at the cost of his fortune—and won the Donglin faction's esteem.
In Chongzhen 1 he was appointed Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent and put in charge of the Nanjing Hanlin Academy.
In Chongzhen 1 he was appointed Junior Supervisor of the Household of the Heir Apparent and put in charge of the Nanjing Hanlin Academy.
少詹事 is the junior supervisor of the household administration.
The next year he was summoned as Tutor of the Heir Apparent.
The next year he was summoned as Supervisor of the Household of the Heir Apparent.
詹事 is the supervisor of the household administration.

In Jiangnan alone, if one reckons wealth by land holdings, seven or eight in ten wealthy families count their fortunes in the hundreds, three or four in ten in the thousands, and only one or two in a thousand reach ten thousand.

In Jiangnan alone, if one reckons wealth by land holdings, six or seven in ten wealthy families count their fortunes in the hundreds, three or four in ten in the thousands, and only one or two in a thousand reach ten thousand.
什六七 means six or seven in ten.
The Rites of Zhou list twelve famine policies, and protecting the wealthy comes first.
The Rites of Zhou list twelve famine policies, and protecting the wealthy is one of them.
保富居一 means it is one of the twelve.
Made a Hanlin probationer, he served as Lecturer in the Directorate of Education and acting Vice Director of the Imperial Academy.
Made a Hanlin probationer, he served as Librarian of the Heir Apparent's Library Bureau and acting Vice Director of the Imperial Academy.
司經局洗馬 is the librarian of the heir apparent's library bureau.
He was soon recalled as Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.
He was soon recalled as Junior Supervisor of the Household of the Heir Apparent.
少詹事 is the junior supervisor of the household administration.

The following tenth month, with the capital under martial law, Jiming urged recall of former Grand Secretary Sun Chengzong, an end to empty quarrels, and new military strategist posts as in the Jiajing reign; the Emperor approved all.

The following tenth month, with the capital under martial law, Jiming urged recall of former Grand Secretary Sun Chengzong, an end to empty quarrels, and additional ministers of war as in the Jiajing reign; the Emperor approved all.
增設樞臣 means appointing additional war ministers.
A month later he was made Minister of Rites and Grand Secretary of the Eastern Pavilion, entering the cabinet as chief minister.
A month later he was made Minister of Rites and Grand Secretary of the Eastern Pavilion, entering the cabinet to assist in government.
入閣輔政 does not mean chief minister.

Jiming fought to save them in vain, then knelt at the Huaji Gate from dawn, saying, "Our ancestors' law required three reviews even for genuine capital offenses—how can the imperial prison condemn men to death after a single hearing?"

Jiming fought to save them in vain, then knelt at the Huiji Gate, saying, "Our ancestors' law required three reviews even for genuine capital offenses—how can the imperial prison condemn men to death after a single hearing?"
會極門 is the Huiji Gate; from dawn is not in the text here.
Taking leave of the throne, he expounded the Way of earnestly upholding the Ming dynasty.
Taking leave of the throne, he expounded the way of being generous, broad-minded, enlightened and active.
惇大明作 describes qualities of rule, not the Ming dynasty.
At the beginning of the Taichang reign he was made Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent and lectured before the throne.
At the beginning of the Taichang reign he was made Junior Supervisor of the Household of the Heir Apparent and lectured before the throne.
少詹事 is the junior supervisor of the household administration.

He repeatedly petitioned to train troops and serve in person; the Wanli Emperor was impressed and abruptly promoted him to Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent and concurrent censor of the Henan circuit.

He repeatedly petitioned to train troops and serve in person; the Wanli Emperor was impressed and abruptly promoted him to Junior Supervisor of the Household of the Heir Apparent and concurrent censor of the Henan circuit.
少詹事 is the junior supervisor of the household administration.

The Emperor agreed and ordered the Westerners Long Huamin, Deng Yuhan, and Luo Yagu to work out a new calendar, with Guangqi overseeing the project.
龍華民 is a single given name Huamin.
The Emperor agreed, posthumously naming Guangqi Wendīng and Yiwei Wenkè.
The Emperor agreed, posthumously naming Guangqi Wending and Yiwei Wenke.
Romanize posthumous names 文定 and 文恪 without stray diacritics.
Qian scratched out the entry, that very evening hung up his official cap at the Gathering Stars Gate and went straight home; Zhongxian forged an edict striking him from the rolls.
Qian scratched out the entry, that very evening hung up his official cap at the Lingxing Gate and went straight home; Zhongxian forged an edict striking him from the rolls.
欞星門 is the Lingxing Gate of the academy.
Zou Yuanbiao has left office, Feng Congwu has shut his door, and even the chief grand secretary and chief minister have one after another asked to resign.
Zou Yuanbiao has left office, Feng Congwu has shut his door, and even the chief grand secretary and the Minister of Personnel have one after another asked to resign.
冢宰 is the Minister of Personnel.
That winter in the sixth year the Taicang jinshi Gu Tongyin and student Sun Wenchi were seized by the city patrol for poems lamenting Xiong Tingbi's fate.
That winter in the sixth year the Taicang jinshi Gu Tongyin and student Sun Wenzhi were seized by the city patrol for poems lamenting Xiong Tingbi's fate.
孫文豸 is read Sun Wenzhi.
He was made Left Messenger and served as a daily lecturer at court.
He was made Left Admonisher of the Heir Apparent and served as a daily lecturer at court.
左中允 is an office in the Supervisorate of the Heir Apparent.
Zhenmeng replied, "The man who had the worthy killed was the late Director Zhou Shunchang of the Ministry of Personnel.
Zhenmeng replied, "The celebrated worthy who was killed was the late Director Zhou Shunchang of the Ministry of Personnel.
殺名賢者 refers to the worthy who was killed, Zhou Shunchang himself.
In time he was promoted to Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent.
In time he was promoted to Junior Supervisor of the Household of the Heir Apparent.
少詹事 is the junior supervisor of the household administration.
His colleague He Wuzao said, "That man is deeply cunning—how can you trust him so readily?"
His colleague He Wuzou said, "That man is deeply cunning—how can you trust him so readily?"
何吾騶 is read He Wuzou.
Chief Supervising Secretary Xu Yuqing had gained renown for impeaching Wei Zhongxian. Zhenmeng and He Wuzao wanted to appoint him Vice Minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices in Nanjing.
Chief Supervising Secretary Xu Yuqing had gained renown for impeaching Wei Zhongxian. Zhenmeng and He Wuzou wanted to appoint him Chief Minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices in Nanjing.
何吾騶 is He Wuzou; 太常卿 is the chief minister.
The Emperor was indeed furious and rebuked He Wuzao and Zhenmeng for favoritism and obstruction.
The Emperor was indeed furious and rebuked He Wuzou and Zhenmeng for favoritism and obstruction.
何吾騶 is read He Wuzou.
He Wuzao was dismissed; Zhenmeng was stripped of his post and sent home.
He Wuzou was dismissed; Zhenmeng was stripped of his post and sent home.
何吾騶 is read He Wuzou.
Six months after returning home, his nephew Yao Ximu died. Zhenmeng mourned him so bitterly that he too fell ill and died.
Six months after returning home, his nephew Yao Ximeng died. Zhenmeng mourned him so bitterly that he too fell ill and died.
Under the Prince of Fu he was posthumously granted the temple name Wensu.
Under the Prince of Fu he was posthumously granted the posthumous name Wensu.
文肅 is a posthumous name, not a temple name.
Zhou Bingmo, styled Zhongjing, was a native of Wuxi.
Zhou Bingmo, styled Zhongjin, was a native of Wuxi.
His father Zhou Ziyi, a presented scholar under Jiajing, rose under Wanli to Vice Minister of Personnel and was posthumously titled Wenge.
His father Zhou Ziyi, a Hanlin bachelor under Jiajing, rose under Wanli to Vice Minister of Personnel and was posthumously titled Wenke.
庶吉士 is a Hanlin bachelor; 文恪 is Wenke.
He entered the Hanlin as a presented scholar and was appointed Compiler.
He entered the Hanlin as a Hanlin bachelor and was appointed Compiler.
庶吉士 is a Hanlin bachelor.
Under Chongzhen he rose from Reader-in-Waiting to Junior Tutor and submitted detailed proposals for famine relief.
Under Chongzhen he rose from Reader-in-Waiting to Junior Supervisor of the Household of the Heir Apparent and submitted detailed proposals for famine relief.
少詹事 is the junior supervisor of the household administration.

In the second month of the fifteenth year, after the spring plowing ceremony, he requested the recall of former Vice Minister Chen Zizhuang, Sacrificial Official Ni Yuanlu, and others; the Emperor approved and reinstated them all.

In the second month of the fifteenth year, after the spring plowing ceremony, he requested the recall of former Vice Minister Chen Zizhuang, Chancellor of the Imperial Academy Ni Yuanlu, and others; the Emperor approved and reinstated them all.
祭酒 is the chancellor of the Imperial Academy.
He went on: "The Martial Emperor raised seventy-two capital guards, with four hundred thousand troops on the rolls.
He went on: "Emperor Wen (the Yongle Emperor) raised seventy-two capital guards, with four hundred thousand troops on the rolls.
文皇帝 is the Yongle Emperor.
There were another one hundred sixty thousand rotating troops from the Middle Region, Dening, Shandong, and Henan.
There were another one hundred sixty thousand rotating troops from the Middle Region, Daning, Shandong, and Henan.
Vice Minister Wang Ao Yong spoke in its favor.
Vice Minister Wang Aoyong spoke in its favor.
Chen Yan answered with Junior Grand Mentor Xiang Yu's proposal to move the heir apparent south; the Emperor read it and said nothing.
Chen Yan answered with Junior Supervisor of the Household Xiang Yu's proposal to move the heir apparent south; the Emperor read it and said nothing.
少詹事項煜: 少詹事 is the office, 項煜 the man.
Censor Guang Shiheng renewed his attack on the harm done by training levies.
Supervising Secretary Guang Shiheng renewed his attack on the harm done by training levies.
給事中 is a supervising secretary, not a censor.
Censors Wang Weixiao, Compiler Fu Dingquan, and others sent memorial after memorial begging that he be kept on—the Emperor would not listen.
Supervising Secretary Wang Weixiao, Corrector Fu Dingquan, and others sent memorial after memorial begging that he be kept on—the Emperor would not listen.
給事中 is supervising secretary and 檢討 is corrector.
The next year, when the Prince of Tang was enthroned at Fuzhou, he was summoned together with He Wusi and Huang Jingfang.
The next year, when the Prince of Tang was enthroned at Fuzhou, he was summoned together with He Wuzou and Huang Jingfang.
何吾騶 is read He Wuzou.
From Hanlin bachelor he rose to Junior Tutor and served on daily lecture duty at court.
From Hanlin bachelor he rose to Instructor of the Heir Apparent and served on daily lecture duty at court.
庶子 is an instructor of the heir apparent.
Jingfang was soon promoted to Junior Grand Mentor.
Jingfang was soon promoted to Junior Supervisor of the Household of the Heir Apparent.
少詹事 is the junior supervisor of the household.
In the fourteenth year he served as Grand Mentor while also heading the Hanlin Academy.
In the fourteenth year he served as Supervisor of the Household of the Heir Apparent while also heading the Hanlin Academy.
詹事 is the supervisor of the household.

When Xue Guoguan fell, his client Wang Biyan of Shanghai was arrested; having long borne a grudge, Biyan claimed Yuegong had once given Guoguan three thousand taels of gold, and Yuegong was arrested.

Dejing answered that he had been implicated through Shiyan; the Emperor nodded.
Dejing answered that he had been implicated through Biyan; the Emperor nodded.
陛彥 is Biyan, the client Wang Biyan.

Before long Supervising Secretary Fang Shiliang recommended Yuegong and Chen Hongmi, prefect of Suzhou; Yuegong was promoted to Vice Commissioner of Shandong while also serving as Right Assistant Commissioner, with general charge of Jiangnan grain reserves.

Qiu's son Zhitao was young but capable and resourceful.
之陶 is read Zhitao, not Zhizhi.

Zhitao was captured and employed as an aide in the military government; soon he was made vice minister of that government to guard Xiangyang.

Chuanting relied on the inside contact and advanced camp after camp; Zhitao indeed raised signal fires, reporting that the Left Garrison's troops had arrived in force.

Zhitao cursed loudly, "I regret I could not cut you into ten thousand pieces—how would I follow you in rebellion!"
